limitations: The interactive Top-K plot uses the user-supplied JSON verbatim. Its upstream generation method and patient-level predictions are not included; fractional K values are retained.

Figure 3 explicitly draws DD–P1 and DD–P2 edges although the strict common-neighbor rule over the two record triplets would only connect DD to H1. The reproduced illustration is kept separate from the existing rule-based teaching builder; no such additional edges are inferred as real observations.
Figure 4 uses MLP; text Equation 9 specifies a linear classifier plus sigmoid. The visual follows the supplied figure without asserting an additional implemented model architecture.
